input.subject: Urgent electrical safety issue – 9 Heron Walk, Ashbourne Green (ref R/5)
input.body:
Dear Landlord,

The tenant at 9 Heron Walk, Ashbourne Green, ZZ2 4ZZ (ref R/5) has reported that the bathroom ceiling light flickers and gives off a faint burning/plastic smell after it has been on a while.

This matches what the contractor who replaced the extractor fan told us in March: the same light fitting had a scorched/browned diffuser and the loft wiring looked old and brittle, and he suggested having an electrician look at it. Together these are signs of a possible overheating fault and fire risk, so we are treating it as an emergency.

We've asked the tenant to stop using the light, to switch off the lighting circuit at the consumer unit if they can do so safely, and not to touch the fitting. We are arranging urgent attendance by a qualified electrician to make the circuit safe and inspect the fitting and the loft wiring. Because this is a safety emergency, we are going ahead with making it safe without waiting for your approval. We don't have a cost yet. Once the electrician has assessed it, we'll send you their findings and a quote for any further repair or rewiring for your approval before anything beyond making it safe is done.

If you have an electrician you'd like us to use, please reply today and let us know.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
